title: Risky container build or runtime setting (envsecret) — review required
description: Container configuration runs risky: ENVs+w*(?:PASSWORD|SECRET|KEY|TOKEN)s*= (envsecret). Root users, network fetches at build, embedded secrets, and host-equivalent runtime flags each widen container breakout or supply-chain impact. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms necessity or hardens it.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of deployment trust.
